description: Rhode Island motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: A Rhode Island rider who is age 21 or older
options: Must wear one on every trip
questions.explanation: The Rhode Island age rule is aimed at riders 20 and younger. Some states add a novice or insurance condition, so read the statute before riding without a helmet.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Rhode Island?
questions.explanation: Rhode Island helmet law: riders under 21.

questions.q: What does Rhode Island law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
questions.explanation: Rhode Island: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

questions.q: What does Rhode Island require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Rhode Island: eye protection is required for all riders.

questions.q: In Rhode Island, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Rhode Island issues a motorcycle permit at 16 years at the earliest.
